description: Send a magic link email to link an existing RentAHuman account to the current Slack user. Use when a user says they already have an account and wants to link it. Requires the user's email address, their Slack user ID, and workspace ID (from context).

slack_user_id.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
slack_user_id.title: minLength(1)

slack_workspace_id.description: a string at least 1 character(s) long
slack_workspace_id.title: minLength(1)

name: request_account_link
